about: Which single-gene traits the Inheritance tab reads, and which ClinVar record and OMIM entry each one uses. This file only chooses: the variant allele comes from the ClinVar record whose condition matches `clinvar`, and the mode of inheritance from HPO's annotation of the `omim` entry (data/reference/hpo/phenotype.hpoa). A trait whose entry HPO gives no mode is shown with the child's genotype odds and 'mode not given by a source'. Several rsids form one gene: their variant alleles are counted together, each parent passing one of two copies.

chip_accuracy.source: Weedon MN et al. Use of SNP chips to detect rare pathogenic variants: retrospective, population based diagnostic evaluation. BMJ 2021
chip_accuracy.common: sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value were all above 99% for 108 574 common variants directly genotyped on the SNP chips and sequenced in the UK Biobank
chip_accuracy.very_rare: for variants that are very rare in the population, with a frequency below 0.001% in UK Biobank, the positive predictive value was very low and only 16% of 4757 heterozygous genotypes from the SNP chips were confirmed with sequencing data
